results.title: Nightgame
results.overview: When two friends discover the archived livestreams of an obscure "pickup artist", they spend a kratom fueled night watching his videos for laughs. Weeks later, they recognize one of his targets as a woman recently reported missing and realize the videos may actually contain evidence of a terrible crime.

results.title: Jodi
results.overview: A horror comedy made in Indianapolis about a woman named Jodi, a wannabe 80’s video vixen who likes locking men in her torture shed. Jodi loves her girlfriend TJ more than anything, and the feeling is mutual. So when TJ finds out about the shed, she tries her best to help the victims…but only makes it worse.  Jodi is a wild romp about the pleasures of rock n roll, sapphic love, and torture…don’t miss it!!

results.title: Foreign Travel
results.overview: A year in Berlin: Leonie wanders through the city and the texts of Anna Maria Ortese. Speaking with friends and translator Sigrid Vagt, she is also looking for the narrative threads of her own life. A film of reading shot in glowing, matter-of-fact 16mm.

results.title: Give it a Shot
results.overview: In India and the U.S., scientists are developing a new male contraceptive that could revolutionize family planning and transform women’s lives worldwide. The film follows the researchers as they strive to successfully launch a reversible male contraceptive—the first breakthrough since the modern condom was invented 200 years ago.

results.title: Margot
results.overview: Margot takes Pete to her childhood cabin for the weekend. Everything is going perfectly, until they realize someone else has also been staying at the cabin. The film explores female sexual expression, the ache of nostalgia, and the struggle to stay true to yourself.

results.title: A. Rimbaud
results.overview: Follows French writer Arthur Rimbaud from his schoolboy days in Charleville to his final years in Africa.

results.title: How Brief
results.overview: HOW BRIEF is a disappearing act set over the course of one night in 1962 when a restless woman returns to her childhood home for the last time, inspired by the music of singer-songwriter Connie Converse.

results.title: Unfading
results.overview: This visually evocative drama, directed by the legendary Marlen Khutsiev and completed after his death, is inspired by the real-life encounters between Anton Chekhov and Leo Tolstoy. Through a series of intimate conversations, the two literary giants confront the fundamental questions of existence—life, death, faith, and immortality. In doing so, they reveal profoundly different worldviews, yet ones rooted in a shared cultural tradition and bound by mutual respect.  In 2026, the film was finished at the initiative of Marlen Khutsiev’s friends and colleagues.

results.title: Dreams in Nightmares
results.overview: Following an abrupt layoff, a queer Black woman embarks on a Midwestern road trip with her two best friends to find a missing companion, only for shapeshifting urban threats to expose deep ideological fractures within their group.

results.title: These Are My Friends!
results.overview: A comedy that follows various mid-twenties drifters over the course of one party in Philadelphia.

results.title: The Indies
results.overview: In 17th-century Europe, Alejandro, a young Spanish nobleman, is tasked with delivering the portrait of the Infanta of Spain to Louis XIV, still a child. It is intended to seal the alliance between the two crowns. Fascinated by the promises of the New World, lands to be conquered and new trade routes to be opened, Alejandro is escorted by two French soldiers. As the portrait advances, the trio descend deeper into a Europe ravaged by wars and uprisings. The journey to the French court is long and arduous, and the path back to civilization and the modern world emerging remains uncertain.

results.title: Before I Do
results.overview: A lakeside bachelor party weekend devolves into chaos when the groom, John Michael, and his best man, Alex, find their past romantic feelings reigniting. Their chemistry entangles the entire wedding party in pre-wedding drama, including friends Luís, Simon, and the newly out and bisexual Kit.

results.title: Raging
results.overview: A young man’s quest for truth and justice interwines with a plane crash mystery, uncovering a sinister plot that propels his desire to be heard but also threatens his community.

results.title: Filmtelligence
results.overview: The shy Ruslan Romanov and the brash Lev Zaretski, who previously launched a film review outlet in KINOMANTRA and a moviemaking company in CINEMAGIC, now reveal their AI startup FILMTELLIGENCE with ludicrous results. No generative AI was used in the making of this work.

results.title: Miami Magic
results.overview: Nora has been living in NYC, following her dreams of “aspiring comedy writer,” but teaching took over, a job she’s just quit or been fired from — it’s complicated. Before she can figure out her next move, Nora finds herself back home, in Miami– Kendall, to be exact, dressed as a dancing grape, performing at children’s birthday parties with her Abuela and Tio.  This particular party turns out to be Nora’s worst anxiety nightmare come to life. All of her high school nemesis, crushes, and most memorable classmates are there, watching her fail. Except, maybe she’s not failing at all. Maybe she’s just growing, transitioning from one version of herself to a better one. And maybe, just maybe, those Octo/Nonagenarians she’s working with might have something to teach her after all.

results.title: Cosmic Trace
results.overview: Hyeonji, an assistant producer for a YouTube channel, and Jihyeon , a struggling actor, continue living together while grappling with anxieties about the present and the future. When Hyeonji's father dies suddenly and Jihyeon's mother is diagnosed with terminal cancer, they find themselves overwhelmed.

results.title: Romance in Christmas Town
results.overview: A Christmas booking blunder in Frankenmuth, Michigan's beloved Bavarian village known for year-round Christmas charm, forces two families to share a B&B, where sparks fly, plans unravel, and romance sneaks in.

results.title: Perfectly Simple
results.overview: A couple comes to terms with their relationship while traveling across state lines to get an abortion. Based on the short story "Hills like White Elephants" by Ernest Hemingway.
